Studied: Fabrication.description:
🛠️ You learned to make things by hand: a technical school, a machine shop job, welding classes or a family workshop.

🌱 Machining, welding, soldering, wiring and reading plans. You can repair a broken support item when the parts exist.
⚠️ Precision parts, unusual materials and complex electronics still need better tools and time.
⚖️ Making weapons or illegal gear is a crime, and workshop rules decide who runs the heavy machines.
🏫 It shows in small burn marks, steady hands and pockets full of tools.

📈 Grants: Fabrication +15
Studied: Fabrication.traitNarrativeEffects: The character has trained in hands-on making: machining, welding, soldering, wiring, sewing heavy materials, reading plans and assembling parts that fit. They can repair a broken support item when the parts exist. Prior study, not mastery: precision parts, unusual materials and complex electronics still need better tools and time. Not a license: making weapons or illegal gear is a crime, and workshop rules decide who may run the heavy machines. It shows in small burn marks, steady hands and pockets full of tools.
